create_struct_of_array_dataclass: use the StructOfArray decorator to create a frozen dataclass that represents a struct of arrays with JAX pytree support
slice_struct_of_array_instance: index a StructOfArray instance with a key to slice all array fields and return a new instance
get_struct_of_array_shape: access the shape property of a StructOfArray instance to get the common shape across all array fields
get_struct_of_array_dtype: access the dtype property of a StructOfArray instance to get the common dtype across all array fields
replace_struct_of_array_fields: call the replace method on a StructOfArray instance to create a new instance with updated field values
